To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

high-performance exporters were found to have more export-oriented organizational characteristics, more export-oriented decision-maker characteristics, more foreign target market characteristics, more export marketing strategies, and a more export operating unit structure than low-performance exporters.

the operating environment (e.g., organizational characteristics, foreign target market, decision-maker characteristics), export marketing strategy (e.g., export commitment, product development, and market development), and export operating unit structures (e.g., centralization, formalization, and specialization) are important factors affecting export performance.
high-performance exporters are more likely to be large, have a higher level of export sales, and be located in the northern part of Taiwan.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between the firm's operating environment, export marketing strategy, export operating unit structure, and export performance.

the following: (1) the relationship between environmental variables and export performance, (2) the relationship between export marketing strategy and export performance, and (3) the relationship between the export unit structure and export performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the export marketing strategy of a firm and the export operating unit structure are the most significant factors that determine export performance.
the export performance of a company is a function of the interaction between the operating environment, export marketing strategy, export operating unit structure, and export performance.
the more the environment, strategy, and structure variables are consistent with each other and with the firm's export performance, the better the export performance will be.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the export performance of Taiwanese manufacturers is influenced by the interaction among environmental factors (operating environment, export marketing strategy, export operating unit structure) as well as the export marketing strategy and export operating unit.
firms with better export performance tended to be larger and had more foreign market experience.

high-performance exporters were more likely to be large companies, to be in the metal products or transportation equipment industries, to have a high level of export sales, to be in a foreign market where there was little competition, to be in an industry with a high level of technological development, to be in industries with a high level or research and development (R&D), and to be in an export operating unit structure that was more centralized than decentralized.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the export marketing strategy and export operating unit are the key factors affecting export performance.
the export performance of firms is a function of the operating environment, export marketing strategy, export operating unit structure, and the interaction of all three factors.
the export marketing strategy and export operating structure were the most important factors that distinguished the performance of exporters.
